title: ALKEMIE Agent: an autonomous platform for computational materials design
abstract: arXiv:2608.15776v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite the powerful multi-scale modeling methods and high-throughput infrastructures established in the materials community, real material computation workflows remain fragmented and heavily manual, requiring researchers to constantly bridge software tools, data analysis, and intermediate decisions. This growing gap between methodological capability and practical execution highlights the need for a new kind of autonomous computational framework, one that can coordinate tools, knowledge, and workflows in a more unified and adaptive way. Here, we introduce ALKEMIE Agent, an agentic platform in which retrieval-augmented generation, a materials-computation knowledge base, registered skills, database-supported provenance, AI-assisted structure modeling, bounded task execution, tool-calling iteration, and error-diagnostic assistance are integrated within a traceable control loop. translated_title: ALKEMIE Agent：一个用于计算材料设计的自主平台
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15776v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：尽管材料界已建立了强大的多尺度建模方法和高通量基础设施，但实际的材料计算工作流仍然碎片化且高度依赖人工，要求研究人员不断在软件工具、数据分析和中间决策之间进行桥接。方法论能力与实际执行之间的这种日益扩大的差距，凸显了对一种新型自主计算框架的需求，这种框架能够以更统一和自适应的方式协调工具、知识和流程。在此，我们介绍了ALKEMIE Agent，一个代理平台，其中检索增强生成、材料计算知识库、注册技能、数据库支持的可追溯性、AI辅助结构建模、有界任务执行、工具调用迭代和错误诊断辅助被集成在一个可追踪的控制循环中。通过从头到尾的自主工作流演示，包括结构构建、计算设置、执行、数据提取、分析和决策制定，我们展示了ALKEMIE Agent在简化复杂材料设计任务方面的能力，并强调了其作为该领域更广泛自主研究催化剂的潜力。
tldr: 本文提出了ALKEMIE Agent，一个集成了检索增强生成、知识库和自主错误诊断的代理平台，通过可追踪控制循环实现材料计算工作流的全自动化，显著减少了人工干预。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ALKEMIE Agent, an agentic platform integrating retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge base, and error diagnostics within a traceable control loop to fully automate materials computation workflows, significantly reducing manual intervention.
